content: Yoni toꞌabihebabitaiso ꞌina ꞌamasa
Tuta nage ꞌoina Helodi, tauna Galili ꞌana toloina, Yesu ꞌina paihowa wasana ꞌihesagoheya,
ta ꞌina topaihowao ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Beno loheyaina tauna Yoni toꞌabihebabitaiso, ꞌabehega ꞌamasega ꞌitoholo hila pwaiya, ma ꞌoinega maꞌina waiwai ꞌipaipaihowa.”
Weyahina mwalo Helodi Yoni ꞌiꞌabiyahiya, ma ꞌipaiya, ma deliya ꞌilaguya. Ma Yoni ꞌana ꞌabiyahina huhuna beno ꞌaigeda wahine sanina Helodiyasa, beno Helodi tasina Pilipi mwanena,
ma Helodi ꞌiꞌwayeya ta ꞌihaiya, ma Yoni Helodi ꞌihegwaeya ꞌigwae, “Nage geya mumuga ꞌausalana, weyahina tasiu mwanena ꞌuhaiya.”
Beno huhuna Helodi nuwanuwana ma Yoni ꞌiloheꞌamasi, ma hesi tomota mabwaiyadi siꞌahwa palopitaeya, ꞌoinega Helodi ꞌimatauta ma geya Yoni ꞌiloheꞌamasi.
Muliyetega Helodi ꞌina sabwelo liꞌu ꞌana ꞌebe nuwatuhu yahina guyaina ꞌoina boda siꞌautama, ma Helodiyasa natuna wahinena boda matadiya ꞌisobusobu, ma Helodi ꞌiꞌabihe yaliyayeya.
Ma Helodi gumalaulauina ꞌoina ꞌigwae helauwa ma ꞌabehega ꞌeguma toꞌaha nuwanuwana ꞌiꞌebwae tuwa, ma wete ꞌigwae hemisa.
Coinega sinana ꞌigwae gumalaulauina ꞌoina, ma gumalaulauina Helodi ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Nuwanuwagu Yoni toꞌabihebabitaiso mwaguna gaeba ꞌoina ꞌulagu ma ꞌuꞌebwaegau.”
Coinega Helodi ꞌinuwagala madouna, ma hesi ꞌina gwae hemisa ꞌinuwatuhu yahiya, ta boda ꞌina hegwaegwae sihesagoha pwaiya, ꞌoinega ꞌitagwala,
ta ꞌina topaihowao deliya ꞌihesumanediya, ma Yoni taniꞌona siꞌupweya,
ma mwaguna gaeba ꞌoina sidoꞌoya ta siꞌeweyama, ta gumalaulau siꞌebwaeya. Ma gumalaulauina ꞌiꞌeweya, ꞌitauyeya sinana ꞌoina.
Ma Yoni ꞌana tomuliyao sinaoma, ta Yoni wahina siꞌeweya, ta silaguya galiha, ma muliyetega sitauya Yesu ꞌoina, ta ginaula bewa sihepwaileya.
Boda madouna Yesu ꞌiheꞌaidiya

Ta Yesu tetelaina bewa ꞌihesagohediya, ꞌoinega ꞌilatuwa ta wagai ꞌigeluwa, ꞌitauya tupwa yoho ꞌawawa. Ma boda Yesu tetelina sihesagoheya, ta ꞌidi ꞌasa ꞌoidiyega silatuwa, ma ꞌedega sitauya Yesu ꞌoina.
Ma tutaina Yesu wagega ꞌiulasuluwa ꞌoyaꞌoya boda madouna ꞌiꞌitediya, ta ꞌina ꞌatemuyemuyega tolohalao ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌanediya.
Ma lahilahiya ꞌana tomuliyao sinaoma ta Yesu sihegwaeya, sigwae, “Bada, tupwa bewa balabala ꞌawawa, ma nata ꞌiboi. Coinega boda bewa ꞌuhesumanedi ma sihila, ma ꞌadi sigimwane ꞌasa deidiya ꞌoidiya.”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Sahena sitautauya, ma ꞌomi hesi ꞌeꞌahai waꞌebwaedi ma siꞌai.”
Ma taudi sigwae, “Ya! Cama geya baibaiwana, beno namo beledi nima ꞌaiꞌaigeda ma silahana ꞌeluwa.”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Beledi ma silahanaedi waꞌebwaegau.”

Coinega boda ꞌiloinaediya ma modumoduwa simiyatoiya, ma beledi nima ꞌaiꞌaigeda ta silahana ꞌeluwa ꞌiꞌewediya, ma ꞌiꞌita haneya galewa, ta ꞌeꞌahaiyedi weyahidi ꞌigwae helauwa, ma muliyetega beledi ꞌigimwahisiya, ta ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌiꞌebwaediya, ma taudi tomota ꞌoidiya siheguyaiya.
Ma mabwaiyadi siꞌaiya ta simwausuwa, ma ꞌeꞌahai tupwatupwadi sidomwa ꞌautediya, ma kodo tuwelo silohemahediya.
Toꞌaiyedi loheloheya daisidimo ꞌadi baibaiwa paibi tausani gide, ta wete wahiwahine ma gwagwama geya sihasilidi.
Yesu hola debanega ꞌitauya
Coinega ꞌana tomuliyaowedi ꞌiloinaediya, ma wagai sigeluwa ma ꞌabehega sinugeta hali tupwa, ma tauna ꞌabehega tomota mabwaiyadi ꞌihegwaedi ma sihila ꞌidi ꞌasa.
Sigeluwa, ma Yesu boda ꞌihewasaediya, ta muliyetega tauna ꞌiboinamo ꞌoyai ꞌihaneya sabi ꞌahwanoi Yehoba ꞌoina, ma ꞌiboiya. Ciboi pwaiya, ma Yesu ꞌiboinamo ꞌimiyamiya.
Cimiyamiya ta tomuliyaowedi ꞌidi waga siwoseyeya ta sidobi pwaiya niꞌuwa, ma bagodu madouna silobeya ma ꞌidi waga ꞌilolobuibui, ta wete yaumai matadiyega ꞌinaonaoma.
Gona ꞌadaꞌadaleya Yesu hola tabwanega ꞌitautauyama, ma ꞌana tomuliyaowedi deidiya ꞌilatuwa.
Cana tomuliyaowedi Yesu siꞌiteya hola pwatanega ꞌinaonaoma, ta simatauta madouna, ꞌoinega siꞌalabwauwa, ꞌidi nuwatuhu ꞌabehega welabana siꞌiteya.
Ma Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, “Sahena wamatauta. Taugu tuwa, ꞌimi Cinapwana.”
Ma Pita ꞌigwaeya, “Bada, ꞌeguma ꞌowa, ꞌuhegwaegau ma hola pwatanega yanaowa ꞌoiuwa.”
Ma Yesu ꞌigwae, “Cunaoma.” Coinega Pita wagega ꞌisuluwa ma hola pwatanega ꞌitauya Yesu ꞌoina.
Citautauya ma yaumai madouna ꞌiꞌiteya, ma ꞌimatauta, ta holai ꞌidamana, ma ꞌibwauwa, “Bada ꞌuꞌabihetegau!”
Ma Yesu ꞌilomwayamwayauwa ma Pita ꞌiꞌabiyahiya, ta ꞌigwae, “Tohemisa ꞌiꞌiuu, toꞌaha weyahina ꞌuhenuwanaluwa?”
Coinega siteluwa wagai sigeluwa, ma yaumai ꞌiꞌata.
Ma taudi waga ꞌana tomiyao siꞌetuluha Yesu ꞌoina, ma sigwae, “Moisa tuwa ꞌowa Yehoba Natuna.”
Tolohalao ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌanediya tupwa Genesaleta ꞌoina
Eema sihabala tupwa Genesaleta ꞌoina ma sisuluwa ꞌoyaꞌoya.
Sisuluwa ma tupwaina ꞌana tomiyao Yesu siꞌinaneya, ta wasa sihedabalaleya ꞌidi ꞌasa mabwaiyana ꞌoidiya, ma ꞌidi tolohalao mabwaiyadi siꞌewedima Yesu ꞌoina,
ta siꞌahwanoiyeya, sigwae, “Bada, sawasawahina ma tolohalaowedi ꞌa ꞌaleꞌo papalina siꞌabitoho?” Ta Yesu ꞌitagwala, ma taudi ꞌana ꞌaleꞌo siꞌabitohoya sibwebweꞌana.
